about: Bradford West Gwillimbury is a town in Simcoe County at the north end of the Holland Marsh, where Highway 400 meets the marsh vegetable fields. Bradford is the urban centre; Bond Head and rural lots sit west of the 400. The town has grown quickly as a commuter community between York Region and Barrie. About 43,000 people live in Bradford West Gwillimbury.
seoSummary: Simcoe County town at the Holland Marsh, a fast-growing commuter centre on Highway 400.
